walkthrough-littleroot.note: Begin in Littleroot, meet your rival north of Oldale, then return to the laboratory.
These are ordinary wild encounters. The story rescue uses Stunky separately. You receive Poké Balls after the rival battle and return to the lab.
Head north from Oldale. At this point, wild battles are for training; return to the lab after beating your rival to unlock catching.
Once you have the Poké Balls, you can catch these partners on your way back to Oldale.
Use a Pokémon Center PC to withdraw Da Bug. It is a gift, not a wild encounter.
Your next route is west of Oldale.

walkthrough-petalburg.note: Walk west from Oldale. Grass encounters are available now; water encounters need later tools.
Try DexNav in Route 102’s grass after receiving it at the laboratory.
After the catching tutorial, leave Petalburg to the west.
Travel north from the coastal cottage into the woods. Route 104’s indexed encounter table is shared across its northern and southern stretches.
The Aqua grunt is a trainer battle along the forest path. Wild encounters for the woods are shown in the preceding section.
Follow the bridge and road north into Rustboro. These use the same Route 104 encounter table shown before the woods.

walkthrough-rustboro.note: Roxanne’s team is a Gym trainer battle, not a wild encounter table.
Go east from Rustboro to reach the tunnel entrance.
This is the Rustboro-side entrance. The blocked tunnel crossing is not required for Peeko’s rescue.
Return west along Route 116 to the Devon employee in Rustboro.
Return south through the woods to Mr. Briney’s coastal cottage. Dewford is the boat destination; this section does not describe a walkable path over the sea.

walkthrough-dewford.note: Cave floors share one regional marker, but have separate wild tables.

walkthrough-mauville.note: Before Surf, only the western bank of Route 118 is reachable.
Route 111’s desert requires Go-Goggles; its desert catches are not available yet.

walkthrough-meteor-falls.note: Deep Waterfall passages are later areas, not part of the first story visit.

walkthrough-norman.note: Surf is available after the Balance Badge. The Good Rod is collected on Route 118 during this chapter.
New Mauville is an optional side quest; complete Wattson’s request and key conversation before visiting.

walkthrough-fortree.note: The institute is on Route 119. Castform is a gift, separate from wild catches.

walkthrough-lilycove.note: The hideout marker shows its region-map area. The listed floors use separate encounter tables.
The northeast hideout is in Lilycove’s region-map area. Scripted item-ball encounters are not ordinary wild tables.

walkthrough-mossdeep.note: Super Rod methods become available after you collect the rod in Mossdeep.

walkthrough-sootopolis.note: Underwater access leads into the cavern. Regional markers show the named cave area, not an exact indoor puzzle path.
